input.quote: 15.11 Limitation of Liability. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW AND NOTWITHSTANDING ANY PROVISION IN THIS AGREEMENT TO THE CONTRARY, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL, RELIANCE OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES OR LOST OR IMPUTED PROFITS OR ROYALTIES OR COST OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES
input.rationale: Section 15.11 is the only limitation-of-liability provision; it contains a mutual waiver of indirect/consequential damages (and deems speculative future sales and contingent Article 6 payments to be consequential damages) but no aggregate monetary cap of any kind. Article 12 indemnities, the 13.6 disclaimer and the 14.4.2 exclusive-remedy provision (which only channels SFJ's termination damages into the Section 14.2 payments) contain no cap either, and a document-wide search found no \"aggregate liability\" or \"shall not exceed\" language. PB's direct liability is therefore unlimited, which fails the fallback requirement of a mutual cap based on 12 months of fees with carve-outs. We have added a single mutual cap sentence at the fallback level (12 months' fees, no USD 1,000,000 greater-of floor volunteered) with the four fallback carve-outs. The existing final sentence of 15.11 preserving PB's Article 6/14.2 payment obligations is retained, so the cap does not disturb the payment mechanics.

proposal.summary: Add mutual 12-month fees liability cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 waives indirect damages but leaves both Parties' direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual cap at twelve months' fees, which is our fallback position. Indemnification and confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct sit outside the cap.

ops.text: Except for each Party's indemnification obligations under Article 12, each Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article 10, and each Party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
